_comment: Codex lanes. /arch-advisor:configure saves model/default effort outside the plugin cache. Override via ARCH_ADVISOR_CONFIG, project .arch-advisor/lanes.json, or Claude config directory arch-advisor/lanes.json. Claude selections are applied through generated native arch-advisor-selected agents.
_efforts_note: All shipped Codex lanes declare low, medium, high, xhigh and max. none, minimal and ultra are intentionally omitted. Earlier repository CLI probes (Astra on 2026-09-05, Luna on 2026-09-22) reported additional options, including none/ultra on Luna; those historical results do not change this allowlist. Live model access and accepted efforts depend on the account and CLI. scripts/smoke.sh probes one declared effort per lane.

routine.route_when: The spec fully determines the outcome: mechanical edits, renames, wiring, boilerplate, tests that mirror an existing pattern, ordinary features with a design decision or two.

complex.route_when: Judgment the spec cannot capture decides the outcome: subtle concurrency, non-trivial algorithms, security-sensitive paths, gnarly debugging, wide-blast-radius refactors, or the routine lane already failed on a corrected spec. Also the second runner when racing two lanes on one spec.

2nd-advisor.route_when: Read-only independent advice at commitment boundaries, after two failed attempts, and once at the end of each deliverable. Never implements.
